name: 46617 · South Bend, IN
findings: ZIP 46617 (South Bend) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46617 (South Bend) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
72% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46617 (South Bend) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 83% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
